# v1.13.1 — Delete uploaded files

## Web app

- The project **Datoteke** page now has an **Obriši** (delete) button on every file, in both list and grid views.
- Deletion asks for confirmation ("Trajno obrisati datoteku …?") and shows a clear error if it fails.
- The file list and download button no longer rely on scraping the page markup for the filename — the download keeps the original name reliably.

## Mobile app

- Every file row and grid card in the **Datoteke** tab now has a delete action alongside share.
- Deletion shows a confirm dialog ("Brisanje datoteke — Trajno obrisati …?") and reloads the list afterwards.
- Mobile version: **1.13.1+21** (CI syncs `pubspec.yaml` from the repo `VERSION` and stamps a date-based version code).

## API

- New authenticated endpoint `DELETE /api/files/{file_id}`: removes the stored file, its JPEG thumbnail, and the database row, then broadcasts the project `files` sync event so web and mobile clients refresh live.
- The endpoint is additive and follows the existing shared-workspace rules (any authenticated user of the instance can delete files, same as uploads).
- No existing endpoints or response fields changed.

## Verification

- Backend: `py_compile` passed; new deletion test (`backend/test_file_deletion.py`) verifies the stored file, thumbnail, and database row are removed and the sync event fires (2 tests passed together with the existing suite).
- Web: `node --check` syntax check passed; verified live in the preview (version `1.13.1` served, delete UI present).
- Mobile: a widget test covers the confirmed delete flow in both list and grid views (`mobile/test/files_screen_test.dart`).

## Deployment

- Docker images are tagged `1.13.1` on GHCR; `dockge-compose.yml` in this commit pins the stack to them.
- Server update: Dockge → pull the new backend/frontend images → `docker compose up -d --force-recreate` → Ctrl+F5.
- The signed Android APK is attached to this release by CI (`solray-1.13.1.apk`) and installs over previous versions (stable signing key verified).
